tool_args.rationale: The verified coupled siphon-memory mechanism requires at least eight rows to identify its five parameters; the offered trajectory batch directly addresses this ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled ODE immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations are insufficient to reliably identify five coupled transient parameters.
It does not discriminate the specified coupled mechanism.
Neither is offered, and the pilot has neither narrow gradient coverage nor a supercritical gradient.
